scope: All 2,000 effective learner-facing cards, including spoken/formal alternates.
principles: Everyday cards should reflect contemporary Iranian Persian rather than dictionary, literary, or historically preserved vocabulary.
Formal/news cards may be formal, but must still be normal in current educated writing, journalism, public administration, or professional contexts.
Traditional cultural expressions may remain only when they are still recognizably used by contemporary Iranians; old-fashioned ceremonial phrasing should not occupy a core slot.
Do not keep obsolete technology merely because it appears in older corpora.
Native Iranian review in Step 23 remains the final authority for borderline generational or regional judgments.
